title: The Hollow
notes: Apex has a boss. Reach its summit and the Dark wakes with eyes. Drive it down three times with perfect drops; rubble feeds it, and it takes loose slabs.
Worlds and a star map. The eight skies are world one, Hearth. Tap the beacons on the title to see the sky: every relit sky a star, the constellation completing when the Hollow falls.
A line of the story before each sky, with what the slab will do there.
A Board button on the title.
